messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: function to print examples
parts:
Hi everyone:
Hadley, correct me if I am wrong but I thought I've seen a ggplot
function that prints examples from your website. I am trying to make a
hard copy of some of the examples listed there.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: function to print examples
parts:
You can recreate the examples with, e.g.

GeomTile$examples_run()
GeomPoint$examples()
all_examples_run()

but that doesn't get them into a form that you can readily print.

Is there a reason you don't just want to print the webpages?

Hadley

In addition: Warning message:
In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE, :
there is no package called 'decumar'

yourself.
